hero.sub: Hey, I'm Proteen Das — Fullstack Developer & Frontend Specialist. I build responsive, high-performance enterprise websites used by global brands, and I'm passionate about AI, chatbots, and LLMs.

paragraphs: I'm a software developer building responsive, high-performance web and mobile applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Flutter, and modern headless CMS platforms — AEM, Adobe EDS, Contentful, and Strapi.
I've led end-to-end delivery of enterprise corporate websites for global brands — owning everything from architecture to production deployment in agile cross-functional teams.
about.quote: "Great interfaces ship when performance, accessibility, and design thinking converge."

bullets: Led end-to-end development of responsive corporate websites for global enterprises — Olam Agri, ofi, and Mindsprint — using Vanilla JS, React, Next.js, AEM, Adobe EDS, Contentful, and Strapi.
Designed front-end code architecture and project structure from scratch: reusable components, routing, CMS integrations aligned with performance and scalability best practices.
Developed multiple POCs to validate new features, third-party integrations, and content workflows across CMS and UI layers.
Independently owned the lifecycle from local development to production deployment, coordinating with designers, product owners, and backend teams.
Trained in enterprise-level web development practices and modern headless CMS platforms.
Contributed to live client projects while learning production deployment workflows and agile collaboration.
Worked on an E-Commerce mobile application built in Flutter, implementing local device storage of user information synced from server.
Developed POCs for a Road Safety & Parking Assistance app and a Learning Management System using Flutter, Firebase, and LangChain.
Contributed as UI Designer alongside engineering responsibilities.
Led the Mobile App Development team, building a fully functional VR mobile application from scratch using Flutter, Firebase, and Unity.
